paragraphs.text: The proposer acknowledges the submission deadline for proposals as specified in the RFP: September 15, 2023, by 4pm. The proposer confirms that their input will be provided to the bid manager by September 8, 2023, ensuring compliance with the stated deadline.

Regarding shipping and handling requirements, the proposer notes that the Metal Clad Switchgear section will be shipped as part of the Prefabricated Equipment Enclosure, with the withdrawable circuit breaker shipped separately from the housing. The preparation for shipment will include bolted shipping splits, and the bus duct transition will require one field weld.
